decisions.reason: The source elevates the overall premium visual positioning but does not change the established beige and green color specifications.
The general intention to brainstorm elevated aesthetics does not change any current name, logo, wording, font, or placard-placement requirement.
The source preserves the engineering and does not alter bowl capacity, depth, or form.
Prioritizing functional proof does not change the existing splash-control behavior or mitigation requirements.
The source contains no decision changing the dispensing mechanism, button interaction, flow, or valve behavior.
The visual-positioning decision does not alter bowl removal, swapping, cleaning access, or event-use behavior.
The client expressly intends to keep the engineering intact and specifies no change to spout geometry, construction, or orientation.
The source does not change the whisk selection, dimensions, attachment, positioning, or removal criteria.
The premium aesthetic objective does not change the platform height, cup clearance, configuration, or mixer fit.
The source reiterates the importance of proving the mixing process but establishes no new mixing result, texture, or acceptance criterion.
No component-selection, BOM, compatibility, or ordering decision is changed by the visual-positioning statement.
The stated sequence of proving functionality before refining aesthetics is consistent with the existing V1 approach and does not change its sourcing policy or scope.
